title: A filter change event needs to be emitted
body:
I have a fair amount of custom code which allows for graceful mobile rendering of search results with their filters.

This all works great until I click on a filter, at which point the view is re-rendered and the bindings of my jQuery are lost etc. I wouldn't mind except that I have no way to destruct my plugins and re-construct.

Maybe `render` should be called again?
